sar.narrative: Customer C09049, holder of linked card C09049-K1, is the subject of this suspicious activity report regarding unauthorized online transactions. Between 2016-11-19 17:09 and 2016-12-03 18:39, three transactions totaling $429.52 were processed on the card using handset device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' behind an anonymous proxy, specifically amounts of $69.92 on 2016-11-19 17:09 (transaction 3470763), $214.75 on 2016-11-20 14:37 (transaction 3473050), and $144.85 on 2016-12-03 18:39 (transaction 3510657). The activity is suspicious because the same device profile was used across 28 cards in a 60-day window around the alert, with all 28 connections routed through an anonymous or hidden proxy and flagged as a new device. Four closed cases on cards utilizing this profile were confirmed fraud with an undocumented pattern, and eight of the eight most similar closed cases (including CC-2985, CC-2649, CC-0849, and CC-3035) were also confirmed fraud. During the session for the $144.85 purchase, the one-time passcode sent to the cardholder's registered phone was not completed. When contacted separately, the cardholder stated they did not make the transactions and still physically holds the card. In response to these findings, the bank has executed automated actions to create a case, monitor connected cards, and escalate to an analyst, while recommending Level 1 card blocking and Level 2 report filing.
